nodes.brief: AF-21.g0.v0: a money-movement and layering scheme targeting the 35-44 age band in the 50-90 balance percentile. It escalates value through a 3-step ladder up to 70% of the target's balance, favouring the a2a channel, with inter-transaction delays around 3.5 log-seconds and a 2.0-hour dwell before cash-out. Funds fan out to 8 mule account(s) across 3 layer(s). When challenged with a step-up it abandons with probability 0.25 and retries after 4 hours. Budget: 8 mule account(s), 2 synthetic identity(ies), 6.0 operator hours.
